_doc: One line per shot. sparse/sketch/colour/end hold spoken lines; objects pairs each region (scenes.json order) with its spoken line and its on-screen caret caption. Sources: examples/raw/v1.1/final.md (T1-T5) and the README blind-test table.

car.headline: New skill: deeper

sparse: There's a new skill for your coding agent. It's called deeper.

blind.headline: We tested it blind.
sparse: Does deeper make a difference? We tested it blind.
sketch: Five real tasks, each rewritten with and without it. A judge on another model scored them out of five, without knowing which was which.
objects: Starting from the raw material: one point eight without it, five with it.
Starts from raw material: 1.8 to 5.0
Expert method: two point six, then five.
Expert method: 2.6 to 5.0
A check outside the model: one, then four point eight.
Check outside the model: 1.0 to 4.8
The judge never saw the key.
Scored without the key
colour: Five tasks is a small test, and every prompt is public.
